_comment: Brain regions = mental domains. `position` is an [x,y,z] anchor in the brain's local space (front = +z). `match` rules assign content nodes; a node can belong to MANY domains (a real knowledge web). Rules are additive (OR). Add/adjust rules here to re-route the KB — no code change.

domains.label: Identity
domains.short: Who I am — the connective core of the mind.
domains.description: The connective core: who I am, how I think, the languages I speak and what drives me. Everything else branches from here.

domains.label: Artificial Intelligence & ML
domains.short: Learning machines: deep nets, RL, generative & symbolic AI.
domains.description: Where I reason about learning machines — deep neural architectures, reinforcement learning, generative and symbolic AI. From transformers and diffusion models to planning and Bayesian inference.

domains.label: Cybersecurity
domains.short: Offense & defense: crypto, pentesting, network security.
domains.description: Breaking and defending systems — cryptography, network security, penetration testing, digital identity and information hiding. Backed by EC-Council hands-on certifications.

domains.label: Data & Big Data
domains.short: Modeling, storing and querying data at scale.
domains.description: Turning raw data into structure and insight — relational and NoSQL modeling, distributed processing, big-data architectures and data science pipelines.

domains.label: Research & Publications
domains.short: Deep dives, papers and open datasets.
domains.description: Where curiosity becomes formal work — investigating open problems, deriving results and writing them up. Papers, theses and published HuggingFace datasets.

domains.label: Programming & Software Engineering
domains.description: The craft of building software — languages from C and Java to Python, clean architecture and design patterns, algorithms and optimization, and full-stack web engineering.

domains.label: Cloud · DevOps · Systems
domains.description: Where software meets infrastructure — AWS cloud services, systems administration across Windows/Linux/macOS, workflow automation and the operating systems underneath it all.

domains.label: Foundations & Theory
domains.description: The bedrock beneath everything technical — calculus and linear algebra, probability, physics and signal theory, control systems, and the philosophy that shapes how I think.

domains.label: Academic Journey
domains.short: Degrees, courses and the path so far.
domains.description: The path so far — from a scientific high-school diploma to a Bachelor's and an ongoing Master's in Computer Engineering at the University of Brescia, and every course along the way. This region also holds the road ahead: thesis, internship and first role.
